column1: # Power-up values of the hardware, inserted module-locally into the sim copies (plan Task 2).
# One row per logical register (amendment A3): signal, candidate modules (exactly one must declare it
# in each revision), power-up value (Verilog literal; converted for VHDL; a memory gets it in every
# element), source, FSM encoding (<fsm> <kind>: <state>=<code> ...; gen_sim --syr compares it with the
# .syr of the compared revision and gives the verdict POWER-UP DIFFERS on a difference).
# Values: XST netlists build/ref/pr07-baseline/<board> (the netlists of a9685c7), extracted with
# FDS/FDSE/FDP/FDPE/LDP = 1; DSP48A1 registers 0; LUT RAM the INIT of its cells. Bits not in the netlist
# Start set (Step 2): the quick init of the spike (plan F17) with the values of the hardware. Added by
# the X-check iterations (Step 3; X on the observed pins, in the SRAM writes or the screen memory):
# Task 3 smoke: loader file_load, CPU H and L; Task 4 basic chain: CRT buf0 and buf1 (VGA X from
# 18.9 ms), CPU B (PUSH B at 56 ms). Reviewed (Step 4): every register row equals the extraction of
# go, mini and minig (power_up_bits of build/sim/sys/extract/regs_<board>.tsv); buf0 / buf1 are LUT RAM
# with INIT 0 in all 24 cells on the three boards.
